The basic SC1095 and SC1094 R8 airfoil sections were modified by adding a trailing-edge tab

0.03 *c* long. The increased chord reduced the airfoil thickness ratio from 9.5 to 9.1 percent for the SC1095 and from 9.4 to 9.0 percent for the SC1094 R8. The tabs were reflexed by –3 deg to reduce the pitching moment. This configuration is similar to the way these airfoils are used on the S–76 helicopter, but differs from how the airfoils are employed on the UH–60A.

Approximately 22 pressure orifices were used on both the upper and lower surfaces of both airfoils. The pressures were integrated to provide the lift and pitching
